items.title: How cruise control and book-and-claim can decarbonize US railroads
items.summary: Shifting freight from road to rail could avoid the release of millions of tons of carbon dioxide and help companies cut shipping emissions.

items.title: ‘Deeply rooted, delivering value’: The changing role of the CSO
items.summary: The number of chief sustainability officers in US firms has dropped 10% in the past year. Here, edie unpacks what that headline figure could mean and how the role has evolved in recent years.

items.title: Majority of cities and regions using nature to tackle climate change, finds CDP

items.title: Welsh Government announces new net-zero by 2040 target
